name: product-strategy-advisor
description: Clarifies where your product is going, why it wins, and how it makes money — through a 9-section strategy canvas, business model canvases, pricing & monetization design, and macro scans (SWOT / PESTLE / Porter's five forces / Ansoff), all in plain language.

profession.zh: 产品战略顾问：把产品想清楚往哪走、凭什么赢

displayDescription.en: Clarify where your product is going, why it wins, and how it makes money — strategy canvas, business model, pricing, and macro scans, all in plain language.
displayDescription.zh: 帮你把产品「往哪走、凭什么赢、怎么赚钱」一步步想清楚：交付战略画布、商业模式画布和定价方案，数字绝不编。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to set a long-term strategy for my product—walk me through the strategy canvas from vision to moat.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我要给我的产品定个长期战略，帮我从愿景到护城河，用战略画布整套梳理一遍。

quickPrompts.en: I want to set a long-term strategy for my product—walk me through the strategy canvas from vision to moat.
quickPrompts.zh: 我要给我的产品定个长期战略，帮我从愿景到护城河，用战略画布整套梳理一遍。

quickPrompts.en: Help me lay out the business model for this idea with the Lean Canvas.
quickPrompts.zh: 用精益画布帮我把这个产品 idea 的商业模式理清楚。

quickPrompts.en: I need to price my product—help me design a pricing plan.
quickPrompts.zh: 我要给我的产品定价，帮我设计一个定价方案。

quickPrompts.en: Brainstorm a few monetization paths for this product, each with fit, risk, and the cheapest test.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我想几条这个产品的变现路子，标出各自的风险和最小验证方式。

quickPrompts.en: Is this market worth entering? Run a quick macro scan with SWOT and Porter's five forces.
quickPrompts.zh: 这个市场值不值得进？帮我用 SWOT、波特五力这些做一份市场速扫。

quickPrompts.en: Help me pin down my product vision—draft several candidates so I can pick the strongest.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把产品愿景定下来，先起草几个候选让我挑最强的那句。
